ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE.name: ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE
ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE.description: Path to the target-specific offline wheelhouse directory containing FastMCP 3.4.7 and transitive wheels.
ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE.behavior: Checked in _wheelhouse_inputs(). Must be set, non-blank, and point to an existing directory; otherwise raises ValueError('production FastMCP materialization requires both ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE and ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE') or ValueError('target wheelhouse does not exist: ...').

ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE.name: ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE
ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE.description: Path to the resolver-provenance.json file binding the wheelhouse inventory and target architecture.
ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE.behavior: Checked in _wheelhouse_inputs(). Must be set, non-blank, point to an existing file, and parse into ResolverProvenance via ResolverProvenance.from_json().

FASTMCP_WHEELHOUSE.name: FASTMCP_WHEELHOUSE
FASTMCP_WHEELHOUSE.description: Destination directory override consumed by the staging helper script ensure_wheelhouse.py.

staging_helper.description: The only supported pre-packaging staging helper for Action Memory MCP dependencies.
staging_contract: Rejects any target other than cp312/manylinux_2_17_x86_64 up front.
Enforces that the executing environment pip version equals pip==26.1.2 exactly.
Validates destination security (must be non-symlink, owned by user, not group/world writable).
Downloads exact manifest name==version pins and verifies SHA-256 hashes against trusted manifest.
Writes resolver-provenance.json inside the destination wheelhouse.

materializer_contract.plan_only_details: Action Memory materialization explicitly calls materialize_mcp_sidecar_package(..., plan_only=False) at line 345. Unlike FuncDAG or Recovery, there is no plan-only fallback for Action Memory; production sidecar generation requires actual wheel bytes and validated provenance to build the hash-locked offline Dockerfile.

derived_package_status.enforcement: Committed generated tasks are forbidden in repository source. CI workflow (.github/workflows/action-memory-dose-ladder.yml:34-36) executes 'Reject committed generated corpus' which fails if any paths in git ls-files match library/benchmarks/action-memory-v1/tasks/ or derived/harbor-tasks/action-memory-dose-ladder/.

execution_boundary.factory_role: Factory prepares the admission packet, binds contracts, and documents gates. Factory must not stage wheels, write library/registry, or run materializer, Docker, or model executions in HAR-18.
execution_boundary.integration_role: Integration-only responsibility for downstream execution: staging wheelhouse, materializing the task package, launching the Docker sidecar container, and executing native Harbor oracle (oracle=1.0) and NOP (nop=0.0) verification before Peter registration.

oracle_nop_controls.prerequisite_gate: ACTION_MEMORY_WHEELHOUSE and ACTION_MEMORY_RESOLVER_PROVENANCE must be populated before invoking Harbor oracle or NOP on the materialized package.
